title: Coastal Sun, Sand-Eating, and Shorebirds: Our Weekend in Ocean Shores
summary: There is nothing quite like a weekend getaway to reset, and our latest trip to Ocean Shores did exactly that. From backyard standoffs to incredible wildlife encounters, it was a weekend full of firsts and fantastic views.
content:
There is nothing quite like a weekend getaway to reset, and our latest trip to Ocean Shores did exactly that. From backyard standoffs to incredible wildlife encounters, it was a weekend full of firsts and fantastic views.

Standoffs in the Yard

We kicked things off just enjoying being down at the shore house. Rainy claimed her territory immediately, completely obsessed with having her own fenced yard to roam. She spent a good portion of the weekend locked in a minor, highly dramatic feud with a local backyard bunny. No harm done, but plenty of intense staring contests ensued!

Sadie’s First Beach Day (Featuring a Sand Buffet)

The absolute highlight of the trip was taking Sadie out for her very first beach day. The ocean air was perfect, but Sadie had her own agenda for the afternoon: attempting to eat as much sand as humanly possible.

When Meaghan and I stepped in to shut down the sand buffet, she was not thrilled. Despite the brief, sandy protest, it was an unforgettable milestone.

Wildlife Action at Oyhut Bay

When we weren't managing toddler culinary experiments, we spent time exploring around Oyhut Bay, and the wildlife absolutely put on a show for us.

The water was teeming with Brown Pelicans. It was incredible watching them glide seamlessly just inches above the surf and then suddenly pivot to dive-bomb straight into the water after fish.

As if the pelican airshow wasn't enough, we caught some high-altitude drama. A massive Bald Eagle made an appearance, only to immediately get completely bullied and chased off by a pair of fiercely territorial crows. You have to love the sheer confidence of a crow.

It was the perfect blend of relaxing family time and incredible nature photography. Ocean Shores delivers every single time, and we're already counting down until we can head back down to the coast.

title: Welcome to Octopus Ave!
summary: The official launch of our blog and social media channels. Follow along as we share our West Seattle shore house lifestyle, coastal decor ideas, and PNW travel vlogs.
content:
We are officially live!

Welcome to our online avenue! We are a couple living right along the shores of West Seattle, and we are so excited to share our daily slice of Pacific Northwest heaven with you. Named after the actual street we live on, OctopusAve is a lifestyle channel documenting our home design projects, beachside routines, and favorite local travel spots.

We are starting this blog in tandem with our brand new channels—make sure to follow @OctopusAve on TikTok and Instagram to see our daily video reels, room styling transitions, and local vlogs!

What You'll Find Here

We want this blog to be an interactive companion to our videos, sharing detailed guides that don't fit into a short TikTok clip:

  • Coastal Modern Interior Design: Step-by-step DIY guides, styling tips, and tours showing how we balance high-end coastal luxury with cozy, organic PNW elements.
  • West Seattle Travel Guides: Hyper-local recommendations for the best coffee walks, beach trials, vinyl crates, and sunset views in our neighborhood.
  • Content Creator Journals: Behind-the-scenes vlogs of what it's like to build a brand, film in a shore house, and connect with other ocean lovers.

We are so incredibly grateful to have you here at the very start of our journey. Grab a coffee, make yourself at home, and let's explore life by the water together!
